title: Files and Mandatory ClamAV
case_ids_frozen_by: P09 contract-freeze revision; Master Plan supplies requirements, not P09-Txxx identifiers

capability_contract.goal: Non-bypassable quarantine, real ClamAV scan and publication chain; every uncertain scan outcome fails closed.
capability_contract.gate_scope: P09-owned CAP-FILES/CAP-CLAMAV contributions only; P17/P22 and release-wide gate obligations remain later-owned.

route_contract.workspace_api_authority_note: The approved IA names fileshare APIs and file/delete APIs but does not freeze exact Workspace HTTP method/path families. The following family is frozen by P09 as the current-repository implementation contract and must not be misrepresented as an IA-exact route family.

public_contract.page: GET /f/{slug}; POST /f/{slug} is the P09 page action for password verification and may establish an opaque HttpOnly authorization cookie without putting the password in a URL.

route_contract.legacy_aliases: PROHIBITED unless later change control approves them

file_state_contract.safety_authority: Server-only. Safe does not auto-publish or grant permission. Quarantined/scanning/blocked/scan_error never authorize new public distribution.
file_state_contract.rescan_authority: A rescan invalidates prior scan authority for new distribution until a new current clean verdict exists.

storage_contract.s3: DEFERRED / not a P09 release dependency
storage_contract.direct_access: private, quarantine and published storage locations are outside direct public access; bytes are mediated by authorized HTTP handlers/internal serving only
storage_contract.naming: server-randomized storage identity; original filename is metadata only and cannot be a filesystem path authority

clamav_contract.production_install_requirement: ClamAV is mandatory; installer/upgrade preflight hard-fails when unavailable, timed out, stale or indeterminate.

environment_contract.filesystem: Isolated native local private/quarantine/published roots; direct web access prohibited.
environment_contract.clamav: Real ClamAV/clamd for clean and EICAR evidence; controlled faults may arrange down/timeout/stale/indeterminate conditions without replacing the production scan client/state machine.
environment_contract.platformapi: Real native Go platformapi; in-memory replacement is insufficient.
environment_contract.fileworker: Real native Go fileworker for claim/scan/restart evidence.
environment_contract.workspace_browser: Built Workspace app; static fixtures are insufficient.
environment_contract.installer: PHP 8.3 installer; P09 proves mandatory ClamAV preflight but not P22 fresh-install closure.
environment_contract.admin: Registered Admin shell may consume P09 status authority; P09 does not claim P17 completion.

cases.name: Upload persists private quarantined file with randomized storage identity
cases.precondition: Real MySQL/local storage and manage actor with quota.
cases.oracle: One same-Workspace resource; original name metadata-only, randomized private storage, initial quarantined, no public bytes.

cases.name: Allowlist MIME and magic mismatch fails before publication
cases.precondition: Allowed/denied extension MIME and magic fixtures.
cases.oracle: Server enforces allowlist, MIME and magic; extension-only trust cannot reach safe/published authority.

cases.name: Workspace file quota is atomic and server-authoritative
cases.precondition: Workspace at/near quota with concurrent uploads.
cases.oracle: Transactional quota denies overrun and denial creates no usable resource.

cases.name: File actions enforce tenant isolation and RBAC
cases.precondition: Two Workspaces and read/manage/unauthorized actors.
cases.oracle: All actions repeat server authorization; read-only cannot mutate, cross-tenant cannot infer existence or obtain bytes.

cases.name: Real ClamAV clean verdict becomes safe but not auto-published
cases.precondition: Benign file and reachable fresh real ClamAV.
cases.oracle: Actual quarantine bytes scan clean with engine/signature evidence; safe only, no automatic publish/permission.

cases.name: EICAR real ClamAV verdict blocks distribution
cases.precondition: Standard EICAR file and real ClamAV.
cases.oracle: EICAR detected; blocked, no publish/download/direct path, only allowlisted reason data.

cases.name: ClamAV daemon down fails closed
cases.precondition: Quarantined file with scanner unavailable.
cases.oracle: Daemon/socket unavailable becomes scan_error/private; no extension/client fallback or optimistic publish.

cases.name: ClamAV timeout fails closed
cases.precondition: Production scan path exceeds timeout.
cases.oracle: Timeout becomes scan_error/private with zero new distributed bytes.

cases.name: Stale ClamAV signatures fail closed
cases.precondition: Signature age exceeds configured freshness contract.
cases.oracle: Stale database never authorizes clean; scan_error/private and health shows stale.

cases.name: Indeterminate or malformed ClamAV response fails closed
cases.precondition: Controlled indeterminate production-client response.
cases.oracle: Anything not unambiguously clean/infected becomes scan_error, never safe/published.

cases.name: Authorized rescan invalidates stale scan authority and preserves evidence
cases.precondition: Safe/blocked/scan_error resources and manage actor.
cases.oracle: Rescan is authorized/audited and denies new distribution until a new real clean verdict.

cases.name: Duplicate claim and concurrent workers are idempotent
cases.precondition: Same queued file can be claimed concurrently.
cases.oracle: Only one active claim; duplicates do not double-process/publish/count.

cases.name: Fileworker service restart recovers without optimistic publication
cases.precondition: Worker interrupted after durable queue/quarantine state.
cases.oracle: Restart/reclaim preserves work and uncertainty remains fail closed until new verdict.

cases.name: Direct quarantine/public storage path access is denied
cases.precondition: Resources exist in native storage lifecycle roots.
cases.oracle: Randomized paths outside web access; traversal/path disclosure/direct storage requests fail; authorized handlers only.

cases.name: Publish is separate permission-gated safe-only transition
cases.precondition: All scan states and manage/read-only actors.
cases.oracle: Only current safe plus manage permission publishes; safe never auto-publishes; uncertain states stay private.

cases.name: Public password and download-limit authorization is atomic
cases.precondition: Published safe password share with download limit.
cases.oracle: Page/binary enforce password and atomic download limit; no password URL/log/plaintext and no bytes before auth.

cases.name: Expiry retention delete and removal deny future public bytes
cases.precondition: Published resources with expiry/retention/delete lifecycle.
cases.oracle: Expired/removed resources cannot produce new bytes; cleanup/quota/storage are truthful and prior client copies are not called revocable.

cases.name: Malformed unknown deleted and dependency errors are stable and non-leaking
cases.precondition: Malformed/unknown/cross-tenant/deleted IDs and controlled faults.
cases.oracle: Shared errors never leak stack/private path/socket secret/cross-tenant data/partial bytes.

cases.name: Installer and upgrade ClamAV preflight hard-fail
cases.precondition: Installer exercises fresh and unavailable/timeout/stale/indeterminate scanner.
cases.oracle: Readiness passes only usable/fresh mandatory ClamAV; every uncertain condition hard-fails; P22 closure is not claimed.

cases.name: File and ClamAV health/admin status is actionable and secret-safe
cases.precondition: Platform health and authorized status consumer.
cases.oracle: Reusable health exposes actionable storage/scan/freshness state without private path/socket/bypass detail and without P17/P22 completion claim.

cases.name: APP-FILES states are route-backed with real file APIs
cases.precondition: Built Workspace/native API with real authoritative dependencies.
cases.oracle: /app/files renders loading/empty/uploading/quarantined/scanning/safe/blocked/scan_error/quota distinct and no fake success before server confirmation.

cases.name: APP-FILE-DETAIL and public file surfaces are route-backed and fail closed
cases.precondition: Real lifecycle fixtures and password-protected published safe share.
cases.oracle: Detail renders server states/actions; /f/{slug} and public binary leak bytes only for authorized published safe state.

cases.name: Canonical desktop tablet and mobile tasks have zero root overflow/clipping
cases.precondition: Real Workspace/Public routes at DS viewports.
cases.oracle: Required tasks pass 1440x900, 1024x768, 390x844 with zero root/body horizontal overflow and no clipped required text/control.

cases.name: P09 Installer/Admin status handoff is route-backed without overclaiming later nodes
cases.precondition: Registered Installer/Admin shells consume P09 health authority.
cases.oracle: /install/environment, /install/services, /install/health and P09 status portions of Admin routes show real healthy/fail-closed authority; P17/P22 completion not claimed.

cases.name: File safety workflows meet keyboard non-color reduced-motion and 320px reflow
cases.precondition: Real safety surfaces with accessibility inspection.
cases.oracle: Keyboard/focus/names/roles/live states pass; five safety states use icon+visible name+reason, not color-only; reduced motion and 320px preserve access with zero root overflow.

cases.name: P09 evidence coherently proves storage scan API and browser authority on one head
cases.precondition: T001-T025 evidence for one SHA.
cases.oracle: One exact commit binds file IDs/storage digests/ClamAV attempts/verdicts/HTTP permissions/browser manifests; mock/manual/UI-derived safety is insufficient.

cases.name: Same-exact-head P09 signed closure and affected regression matrix
cases.precondition: T001-T026 pass, review signable and affected P00-P09 matrix runnable.
cases.oracle: T001-T027, signed review and affected matrix share one exact SHA; P0/P1/DECISION REQUIRED zero; only P09-owned gate contributions claimed.

closure_contract.required_regression_scope: All affected P00-P08 contract, build, unit, integration, browser, security and closure workflows plus P09 producers required by the changed exact head.
closure_contract.gate_scope: P09-owned CAP-FILES/CAP-CLAMAV G3/G6/G10/G12/G13 contribution only; P17/P22 and release-wide closures remain later-owned.
